title: Convergence Rates of Ordering, Testing and Estimation Procedures for Graphons With Fast Boundary Decay Rates
summary: In latent-position random graph models (LPMs), latent vertex positions $U_{1},\ldots,U_{n}$ are sampled from some distribution on a latent space $Ω$, then edges of an observed graph $G = ([n],E)$ are sampled with some probability $\mathbb{P}[(i,j) \in E ]=w(U_i,U_j)$ that depends on the unobserved latent positions. LPMs are ubiquitous in the statistical analysis of networks, offering models that have good empirical performance, strong theoretical guarantees, and tractable algorithms.
